subject: FYI CI run 43980568767 webkit: learn.spec :387 (phone-412) and :357 (laptop-1440) failed on a WebKit aborted-fetch pageerror for /api/public-config
body: One project each; error 'Fetch API cannot load http://127.0.0.1:7860/api/public-config due to access control checks' as a pageerror (WebKit reports a fetch aborted by navigation/reload this way). Waiting for in-flight requests before navigating fixed the same class in today.spec. Job: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43980568767/job/133695637296
